provider: Bunny.net Edge Storage (+ free origin→CDN transit)

free_tier.stated: Unlimited volume, pay-as-you-go. $0.01/GB/mo HDD per region (up to 9 regions), $0.02/GB/mo SSD per region (up to 15). 20 TiB single-region HDD = $200/mo. $1 monthly minimum.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: The structurally important bit: **origin→CDN transit is free** ('Free traffic to Bunny CDN', 'Free API egress'). Only end-user CDN delivery is billed, at $0.01/GB EU/NA, $0.03/GB Asia-Oceania, $0.045/GB South America, $0.06/GB ME-Africa. Or a flat $0.005/GB on the 10-PoP Volume Network. So storage and delivery are one bill with no double charge, unlike B2/R2-style metres.

tooling: S3-compatible API and an HTTP API, FTP/FTPS, plus rclone bunny backend. Limits are per-server: 100 concurrent HTTP connections per IP, 500 RPS per zone, 1 Gbps per connection. Documentation recommends sharding across connections.
chaining: Can front external storage origins such as Hetzner Storage Box or Bunny Storage ($10/TB) with Bunny CDN edge distribution ($5 to $10 per TB delivered). Pull zones can point to any origin endpoint and handle external delivery.
limits_note: per-ip-shaping: 100 concurrent conns per IP per server; 500 RPS per storage zone; 8 MB POST body for zip/download requests; 1 Gbps per connection. Geo-replication multiplies the storage price linearly (2 regions = 2x).
reliability_note: PCI/99.99% SLA on storage; $1 minimum means idle cost is trivial. Card required at signup is the binding constraint, and is why the free CDNs above matter more than Bunny's own storage.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.
